name: race
description: Ancestries with culture, appearance, and suggested traits

fields.Name: Human
fields.Description: Adaptable people found across nearly every region, with highly varied appearances, cultures, and traditions.
fields.Physical Ability: Relentless Endurance: Humans suffer reduced fatigue from prolonged travel, heat, marching, pursuit, and repeated physical activity.

fields.Name: Elf
fields.Description: Long-lived, sharp-featured people known for keen senses, graceful movement, and cultures deeply tied to magic or nature.
fields.Physical Ability: Timeless Vitality: Elves age with extreme slowness, remaining physically healthy and mentally sharp for hundreds of years.

fields.Name: Dwarf
fields.Description: Compact, sturdy people renowned for endurance, craftsmanship, clan traditions, and settlements carved into stone.
fields.Physical Ability: Thick-Skinned: Dwarfs dense skin provides modest natural protection, allowing them to withstand unarmed blows and minor impacts better than other species when not wearing armor.

fields.Name: Orc
fields.Description: Powerfully built people with prominent tusks and diverse cultures that often prize resilience, honor, and collective strength.
fields.Physical Ability: Iron Jaw: Orcs possess exceptionally powerful jaws, allowing their bites to cause serious injury and giving them an advantage when fighting at extremely close range.

fields.Name: Goblin
fields.Description: Small, quick people with expressive features, sharp senses, and a talent for improvisation, trade, and inventive tools.
fields.Physical Ability: Small Target: Goblins small stature makes them more difficult to hit with arrows, thrown weapons, and other projectiles, especially at longer distances.
